data: Which model has the lowest Character Error Rate (CER) at a SNR of 10?

The question asks for the model with the lowest CER at a SNR of 10 dB. From the analysis of the figure, Engine 2 is represented by black circles, Engine 4 is represented by black triangles, and Kaldi chain, multi-condition noise is represented by gray crosses. At an SNR of 10 dB, the line representing Engine 2 (black circles) is below the lines representing Engine 4 (black triangles) and Kaldi chain, multi-condition noise (gray crosses). Therefore, the model with the lowest CER at a SNR of 10 dB is Engine 2.
